messages.author: d275eff513efeea3
messages.subject: Re: simple CFA model ERROR
parts:
Hi Martin,

Probably there are some typos in your variable names?
The variables 037, 038, 039 and 040 start with a zero while the others start with an 'o'.

Secondly, don't forget to include the na.string argument.

data <- read.table("x.dat", na.string="-999")


Leonard.
